 Frequently Asked Questions 

 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 What are my flavor cake and icing options? 
 
 
 We offer White, Butter, Yellow, Chocolate, German Chocolate, Strawberry, Red Velvet, Carrot, Marble, Almond, and Lemon. For icing options we have Buttercream, Cream Cheese, Chocolate Buttercream, Peanut Butter Buttercream, Carmel and Coconut Pecan. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 How can I place a custom cake order? 
 
 
 To place a custom cake order, please call us, visit our shop, or facebook message us!! We recommend placing your order at least 2 weeks in advance. 
 
 
 

 
 
 “I ordered a custom cake for my daughter's birthday and it was absolutely stunning! The attention to detail and the flavors were beyond what I could have imagined. Our guests were delighted!”

 About us
A Specialty Bakery and Party Shoppe has been the go-to destination in Gulf Shores, AL, for those looking to add a touch of sweetness and joy to their celebrations. Our dedication to quality, creativity, and customer satisfaction sets us apart. Making custom cakes that are as beautiful to look at as they are to eat, we're here to ensure your special moments are unforgettable. Let us be part of your next celebration and help satisy your next sweet tooth!!
